title: Warlocks #7 Aircel Comics 1989 Horror Monster Cover Warlock 5 Spinoff Comic Book
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Warlocks #7 (1989), Aircel Comics - the Warlock 5 spinoff series, with a horror monster cover bursting through a stone wall. Original $1.95 cover price ($2.50 in Canada).

Back cover: Dinosaurs for Hire ad from Eternity Comics.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
